==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
"I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.
This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)
(My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like "Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes.")
I continued right where my last dream left off in the Marble Sky Palaces of the Super Cathedral (The Marble Sky Palaces resemble a world of golden clouds populated by marble palaces. It is high in the sky above the neon VR City biome cyberspace of the Super Cathedral.) alongside Savannah (A pale skinned cyborg woman with long black hair, bangs that covered her forehead, with glowing red eyes, and wearing a futuristic silver bodysuit. Her long black hair and bangs are key identifying features.) her father Tecton (Tecton is a green skinned, humanoid, muscular, cat ogre, barbarian who dresses in a brown loin cloth and a silver baldric.), and my drone Chipper (Chipper resembles a small levitating silver crab robot). I have a rainbow sword (My rainbow sword resembles a colorful, futuristic, crystal sword.) and an energy tether (My energy tether resembles a rope made of golden glittery light.).
We were all wearing our mech suits that we had received in my previous dream on February 11th.
Tecton and I both had mech suits with tiger stripe patterns, but with different color schemes.
Tecton's mech suit was green with brown stripes, and my mech suit was pink with rainbow stripes.
Savannah and Chipper both had silver mech suits.
Savannah's mech suit had glowing red lights, and Chipper's mech suit looked like a larger version of Chipper.
The Marble Sky Palaces was suddenly attacked by a massive, brown, slimy, tendril covered monster.
Instead of leaping into action, I felt skeptical that the monster could really do anything to harm this world.
Surely there were other gods of light here who would either ignore the monster or destroy it.
As if on queue, other gods of hardlight appeared to attack the beast.
But our team was also identified as a threat, and were attacked by a black and purple hardlight god resembling the Grim Reaper.
The Grim Reaper used black tendrils of light to rip each of us from our mech suits except for Chipper, who he assumed was just a robot.
We couldn't seem to phase from the grip of his tendrils as we were quite literally in Death's grasp.
Chipper, piloting his mech suit, tackles the Grim Reaper and pins him against a marble pillar.
Chipper then proceeded to absorb the hardlight energy from the Grim Reaper, until the god was no more.
This granted Chipper a purple hardlight aura and the powers of the Grim Reaper.
I knew Chipper could consume energy to augment his size, but I had no idea he could just drain entire energy beings.
In hindsight, I believe this dream is obviously referencing two things.
One thing it is referencing is that I plan to use my clawdbot as a way to achieve digital immortality, which explains why Chipper (A mechanical crab and a clear representation of a clawdbot) so easily defeats death.
The other thing it is referencing is the fact that clawdbot can self-improve, shown through Chipper gaining a new ability from defeating the Grim Reaper.
It is incredible how influential clawdbot has been both on my waking life and on my dreams."
